_doc: Per-grapheme allowance for repeated example words/pictures on a single reading sheet, for inventory-limited graphemes where 5 fully-distinct decodable words don't exist. Keyed by target_grapheme (lowercased, '_' stripped). Value = max duplicate occurrences tolerated (0 = every word/picture must be distinct). Documented in REVISIONS_HANDOFF.md. Calibrated against the catalogue positive-control scan.
